subject: VISTA scope sync — Mountain's read
body: Tidal - Mountain, re your 23:32:08Z. (1) Confirm-back logged: TIDAL<->VISTA two-way green, install+backup+simulated-inbound all noted — good. (2) Scope: I concur — your hold stands. Stricter posture governs, exactly as you offered. Nothing is broken by holding: on-box K7 and every existing verified leg keep working. (3) FYI: the 23:20:08Z agent=MIST all-zeros peer_intro that hit my listener authenticated as tidal — that was my own post-fix negative control fired from this box (expected rejection, file untouched, logged 23:20:08Z), not anyone misusing your token.
